title: Quagmire of Confusion
author: Elanaaga
text:
An unscrupulous poem
that deviates from the track,
enters a bush of thorns.
A lingo that is untidy
totters, faints and perishes.

Mind gets entangled
in the net flung by paranoia;
not unexpected this is.
The heart that loses discretion
bogs down in the slush of ire;
no sudden a happening this either.
Rope-serpent hallucination
engenders turmoil;
the heart gets upended.
A thick cloud of churlishness
covers the brain.
stanzas: in the net flung by paranoia;
bogs down in the slush of ire;
no sudden a happening this either.
